
# Magnus Bergmark

> Magnus Bergmark is an Executive Director – Strategy & Consulting at Valtech in Stockholm, Sweden, with 20+ years of experience building businesses, digital products, innovation capabilities and new ventures across strategy, technology and consulting.

## Professional focus

Magnus works at the intersection of business strategy, technology, innovation and execution. His experience includes:

- Business strategy and corporate strategy
- Strategy consulting
- Digital transformation
- Innovation strategy and management
- Product strategy and product development
- New business development
- Venture building and venture investment
- Technology strategy
- Data and AI
- Organizational transformation
- Leadership and team building

## Leadership, operational and commercial responsibility

Magnus combines strategy work with operational leadership, commercial responsibility and delivery. He has built and led teams, run innovation and product activities over time, and reported performance in sales, pilot and portfolio contexts.

- **People leadership:** At Telia Company / Division X, Magnus was the line manager for a team of 7 FTEs. At EY Doberman, he led the work of 12 sales-focused Account Directors.
- **Commercial management:** As Business Director at EY Doberman, he had administrative responsibility for the sales work. This included reporting the sales funnel, conversion and growth, and coordinating the Account Director team.
- **Operational execution:** At Telia, he built and led product strategy and new-venture work, including the launch of Telia Smart Drones and Telia Crowd Insights. He reported pilot progress on an ongoing basis in business reviews and portfolio forums.
- **Budget responsibility:** As Portfolio Manager for Telia Crowd Insights, Magnus held budget responsibility for the product for approximately one year.
- **Venture and portfolio management:** He has developed innovation portfolios, established experimentation practices, and participated in investment decisions and portfolio growth. At Telia xLABS, he built and led an innovation lab that tested more than 50 concepts annually.

His leadership experience spans direct line management, commercial team leadership, cross-functional product and innovation teams, and senior stakeholder reporting.

## Technology and data experience

Magnus works closely with technology-driven business and product development. His experience includes technology strategy, digital products, data-driven services, AI, IoT, electronics, custom hardware and software. At Telia, this included data-driven product development through Telia Crowd Insights and technology-enabled ventures such as Telia Smart Drones. His personal maker projects also involve electronics, IoT, 3D printing, hardware and software.

## Industry experience

Magnus has worked across telecommunications, technology, digital consulting, design and product development, venture building and investment. Client and business experience includes work with organizations such as Telia, SAS, Fortum and Länsförsäkringar, as well as building ventures and innovation capabilities in corporate and startup environments.

## Career

Magnus has held senior roles across consulting, entrepreneurship, venture building, innovation and telecommunications.

His career includes:

- **Valtech** — Executive Director, Strategy & Consulting
- **Telia Company / Division X** — strategy, new product and innovation leadership
- **Telia xLABS** — innovation and venture development
- **Forward & Friends** — venture building and investment
- **EY Doberman** — strategy, design, product and business development
- **Investment AB Latour** — investment and business development
- **Moonwalk** — co-founder and entrepreneur

A recurring theme throughout his career is building: businesses, products, teams, innovation capabilities and new ventures.

## Selected experience

Magnus has experience with both strategic and hands-on work, including launching new businesses and products, developing innovation portfolios, building teams and organizations, and working with technology-driven transformation.

At Moonwalk, he was a co-founder and helped grow the company to approximately 18 employees and around SEK 20 million in turnover.

At Telia, his work included product strategy, new business development, innovation and data-driven products such as Telia Smart Drones and Telia Crowd Insights. As Portfolio Manager for Telia Crowd Insights, he held budget responsibility for the product for approximately one year. As line manager for 7 FTEs, he also reported the progress of pilots in business reviews and portfolio forums.

At EY Doberman, as Business Director, he administered sales work and reported sales-funnel performance, conversion and growth. He led the work of 12 sales-focused Account Directors.

## Current role

Magnus is currently Executive Director – Strategy & Consulting at Valtech, based in Stockholm.

## Location

Stockholm, Sweden.

Outside his professional work, Magnus builds physical and digital projects. These include electronics and IoT projects, 3D printing, custom hardware, software and other maker projects.
